understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero costs a life before stamina resets. Walls block movement, so blocked_directions must be checked before every action. Shape, color, and rotation modifier tiles cycle the corresponding attributes, while refill tiles restore stamina. A goal activates only when all three piece attributes match; careful route planning is necessary to reach modifiers and goals without wasting moves or lives.
